SELECT collection_upload_provenance_epoch_scans.replay_binding_json 
FROM collection_upload_provenance_journals LEFT OUTER JOIN collection_upload_provenance_epoch_scans ON collection_upload_provenance_epoch_scans.collection_id = collection_upload_provenance_journals.collection_id AND collection_upload_provenance_epoch_scans.journal_id = collection_upload_provenance_journals.journal_id AND collection_upload_provenance_epoch_scans.attempt_id = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_epoch_scans.directory_id = ? 
WHERE collection_upload_provenance_journals.collection_id = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.journal_id = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.state = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.accepted_bytes = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.bytes = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.sha256 = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.capture_source_bytes = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.capture_source_sha256 = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.capture_attempt_id = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.capture_directory_id = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.capture_algorithm = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.capture_phase = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.capture_version = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.capture_byte_offset = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.capture_frame_start IS NULL AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.capture_frame_count = ? AND collection_upload_provenance_journals.capture_failure IS NULL
